say:3:1027208001:0.text: Misarte above, then the legend is true! There's hope for my sick friend!
say:3:1027208001:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒在上，传说是真的！那我朋友的病有希望了！

say:4:1027208002:1.text: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...
say:4:1027208002:1.source_cn: 这都是多亏了你，外来……不，人类朋友！我都不知道该怎么...
say:4:1027208002:1.male: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...
say:4:1027208002:1.female: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...

choice_prompt:5:1027208002.text: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...
choice_prompt:5:1027208002.source_cn: 这都是多亏了你，外来……不，人类朋友！我都不知道该怎么感谢你……
choice_prompt:5:1027208002.male: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...
choice_prompt:5:1027208002.female: It's all thanks to you, outsider... no, friend! I don't even know how to thank you...

say:6:1027208003:1.text: But for me and my friend, it means hope!
say:6:1027208003:1.source_cn: 但对我和我的朋友来说，这是宝贵的希望！

say:7:1027208006:0.text: That said, the legend states the Deer Spirit should reveal itself after the puzzle has been solved... so where is it?
say:7:1027208006:0.source_cn: 话说回来，传说解开谜题之后鹿灵就会出现，怎么没见到啊？

say:8:1027208007:1.text: The Deer Spirit is sacred and doesn't appear easily. I think... all the puzzles must be solved first.
say:8:1027208007:1.source_cn: 鹿灵神圣，不会轻易出现。我想……也许需要解开所有谜题，...

say:9:1027208008:1.text: Yolanda, you should head back soon. The patrol teams will sleep more soundly, knowing you're safe.
say:9:1027208008:1.source_cn: 约兰达，你还是赶快离开这里吧。巡游队的大家看到你平安无...

say:10:1027208009:1.text: Ah! But I don't want to go back before I finish solving the puzzles... If you see them, please tell them not to worry! I'll head back later.
say:10:1027208009:1.source_cn: 啊！你说的没错，我得赶紧去找下一个谜题了！

say:11:1027208010:1.text: Anyway, see you around! Thanks again for your help and wisdom!
say:11:1027208010:1.source_cn: 再见，朋友！再次感谢你的智慧和帮助！
say:11:1027208010:1.male: Anyway, see you around! Thanks again for your help and wisdom!
say:11:1027208010:1.female: Anyway, see you around! Thanks again for your help and wisdom!

say:13:1027208004:1.text: But your wisdom helped crack the puzzle!
say:13:1027208004:1.source_cn: 但是解开谜题的，是你的智慧！
say:13:1027208004:1.male: But your wisdom helped crack the puzzle!
say:13:1027208004:1.female: But your wisdom helped crack the puzzle!

say:14:1027208005:1.text: Of course! All I want is the chance to make a wish to the Deer Spirit to save my friend.
say:14:1027208005:1.source_cn: 这是理所应当的！我只想要向鹿灵许愿的机会，来拯救我的朋友……

choice:5:2:3.text: Then let me have the treasure.
choice:5:2:3.male: Then let me have the treasure.
choice:5:2:3.female: Then let me have the treasure.
